verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own agentic skills that take on delegated work. Examples: /qa tests, fixes bugs and commits each fix atomically; /ship runs tests, bumps the version and opens a PR; /autoplan chains the review skills with automatic decisions; a router skill sends any request to the right specialist skill. Community users corroborate the specialist-persona delegation model. However, the AI is not built in: these skills run inside external host agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.), so the product supplies the delegation workflows and personas rather than its own assistant. Missing for 10: a self-contained built-in assistant that works without a third-party host agent, and independent hands-on verification of the autonomous fix/ship loops.
